chunks: From him, from his father, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Among the most beautiful of beauties is beautiful hair and the melodious tone of a beautiful voice.

key_terms.أَجْمَلِ الْجَمَالِ: Most beautiful of beauties — a superlative construction emphasizing excellence among beautiful things
key_terms.الشَّعْرَ الْحَسَنَ: Beautiful hair — grooming and caring for one's appearance
key_terms.نَغْمَةَ الصَّوْتِ الْحَسَنِ: The melodious tone of a beautiful voice — the musical quality of vocal sound

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about beautiful hair and a beautiful voice in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) reports this saying of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), who highlighted beautiful hair and a melodious voice as among the finest forms of natural beauty. This hadith appears in the chapter on reciting the Quran in a beautiful voice, providing a prophetic foundation for the Islamic appreciation of melodious Quran recitation. The original audience, who prized oral culture and poetry, would have understood this as affirming that beautifying one's voice for Quran recitation is consistent with prophetic guidance.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Abu Baseer,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The most beautiful of the beauties is the beautiful hair and the tone of the beautiful voice’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali ibn Ma’bad from Yunus from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah  (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Holy Prophet has said, ‘The most beautiful thing in beauty is beautiful hair and the attractive tone of voice.’”
